name: Boombrick
description:
Your music, Spotify and YouTube Music in one player for the TrimUI Brick, with album art, synced lyrics and music that keeps playing while you game.

Features:
- Your music: MP3, FLAC, Opus and M4A (AAC) from the SD card, gapless, with ReplayGain levelling
- Browse by album, artist or song; the queue has shuffle and repeat and is kept between launches
- Covers from the files, folder pictures or the Cover Art Archive, with the screen's colours taken from the album playing
- Synced lyrics from the files, .lrc files or LRCLIB, with the line being sung highlighted
- YouTube Music: search, browse albums and artists, and download songs as tagged Opus files with covers and lyrics; a song still downloading plays as soon as it lands
- Spotify (Premium): sign in with a code on your phone, then play Liked Songs and your playlists at 96, 160 or 320 kbps
- Spotify import: download your playlists' songs from YouTube Music to keep them offline, matched by ISRC or by title, artist and length
- Play in background from the quick menu: the music goes on while you play a game
- Sleep timer: 15 to 60 minutes, or the end of the track or album, with a fade
- Screen off with Power, with skipping and pausing still working
- Titles in Latin, Cyrillic, Greek and Vietnamese scripts
- Updates for Boombrick and its downloader from Settings

Wi-Fi is used for Spotify, YouTube Music, covers, lyrics and updates; the music on the card plays without it. Your library and settings are kept in .userdata/tg5040/Boombrick and downloads in Music/Boombrick, so updates never touch them.
author: ujjwal313
